responsible.title: Data Controller
responsible.text: Responsible for data processing on this website:

githubAuth.title: GitHub Authentication
githubAuth.text: When signing in via GitHub OAuth, the following data is retrieved and stored from GitHub:

activity.title: GitHub Activity Data
activity.text: To display your coding activity, the following data is retrieved from the GitHub API:
activity.calendar: Contribution calendar (activity per day for the last 365 days)
activity.note: This data is not permanently stored but is fetched fresh from GitHub on each request.

devlogs.title: Devlog Entries
devlogs.text: Devlog entries you create are stored in our database.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: This website uses the following cookies:
cookies.session: Contains an encrypted token for authentication. Valid for 30 days. Required for using the app.
cookies.csrf: Temporary security token during the login process. Deleted after successful authentication.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.text: This website is hosted by Vercel (Vercel Inc., USA).

database.title: Database
database.text: User data is stored with Supabase (Supabase Inc., USA). Supabase is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

github.title: GitHub API
github.text: We use the GitHub API (GitHub Inc., USA) for authentication and to retrieve activity data. GitHub's privacy policy applies:

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis
legalBasis.consent: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (Consent) – through signing in via GitHub
legalBasis.contract: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (Contract Performance) – to provide the service

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.access: Access to your stored data (Art. 15 GDPR)
rights.withdrawal: Withdraw your consent at any time

deletion.title: Data Deletion
deletion.text: You can delete your account and all associated data at any time. The GitHub Access Token will also be deleted. You can additionally revoke access in your GitHub settings under "Applications" > "Authorized OAuth Apps".

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: This privacy policy may be updated as needed. The current version is available on this page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataPrivacyDescription: Manage your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
settings.exportDataDescription: Download a copy of all your stored data (Art. 20 GDPR - Right to data portability).
settings.deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data (Art. 17 GDPR - Right to erasure).
settings.deleteModalDescription: This action cannot be undone. All your data will be permanently deleted.
settings.deleteModalWhatWillBeDeleted: The following data will be deleted:
settings.deleteModalItem1: Your user profile and all account data
settings.deleteModalItem2: All your Dev Logs and entries

cookies.message: This website uses essential cookies for authentication.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: This website uses only essential cookies required for the application to function:
cookies.csrf: Temporary security token during login (deleted after authentication)

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.description: When you sign in with GitHub, we store your GitHub profile information (username, email, avatar) and any Dev Logs you create. We also temporarily cache your GitHub activity data to display your contribution statistics.

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.description: You can export all your data or delete your account at any time from the Settings page. Upon account deletion, all your personal data will be permanently removed from our systems.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: For privacy-related questions, please contact us through the feedback form or create an issue on our GitHub repository.
